key_decisions: Normal social usage remains free; curiosity, private access, collectibles and identity assets can be paid.
Reveal x2 requires prior consent via anonymous/revealable/mutual-reveal policy.
For Reveal x2, recommended split is 60% to the revealed visitor, 30% to the owner/context creator and 10% to Nexus.
Reviews, trust, KYC, earned badges, dating seriousness and organic reach cannot be bought or transferred.
A transferable Nexus token is still not recommended for MVP/Phase 2; use EGLD, approved ESDT stablecoins, non-transferable points, gas credits and NFTs/SFTs.
